rules: Do not replace asset base globally. Default remains v1; opt-in and validate by effect ID.
Current v1 projectile carrier extraction will not automatically match v2 moving_payload nodes. Use projectile_geometry_subtree metadata and reset it before sim placement.
Only real hit/contact events select impacts. Sequence clips never emit hits.
Host/state-ended/projectile-ended stops owned effects; reset time/TRS/parent/target/endpoints/material/loop before reuse.
Smoke/shield/repair/flame require additional real trigger/host/lifetime adapters; art comparison is not runtime integration.
Comparison0.24 clearance is a display-only provisional fix, not gameplay muzzle authority.
Runtime fade is per instance; faded transparent meshes skip OutlineEffect backface pass to preserve colored fill. Keep ship outline autoClear=true.

compatibility_mapping.muzzle_frame: Use current event/muzzleFrame world position and direction. Align VFX+Z to that direction. Native-rig Y=-pi/2 correction and display0.24 clearance belong only to the comparison; do not apply them a second time to normalized battlefield coordinates.
